newsitem.title: USA: UtiliCorp to redeem preference stock.
newsitem.headline: UtiliCorp to redeem preference stock.

text.p: UtiliCorp United said Tuesday it intends to redeem all one million outstanding shares of the company's $2.05 Series Preference Stock on March 1, 1997. Shares will be redeemed at $25 per share.
Notice of the redemption will be sent to holders of record on or before January 30, 1997, the company said.
The regular quarterly dividend on the $2.05 series stock will be paid on March 1, 1997.
UtiliCorp United provides energy to customers in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand and Jamaica.
